section_summary.extract_value: This study investigated how exposure to non-body focused and body focused others affects young women's eating and body image over a week. The study involved 92 female college students who completed nightly online questionnaires for seven consecutive days. Findings revealed that higher average exposure to non-body focused others predicted greater intuitive eating, body appreciation, and less dietary restraint, while exposure to body focused others predicted the opposite.
